```{r}


#loading data and meta data
#reading raw TSV file
tsv_path <- "C:/Users/anae2/Preeclampsia_Vs_Normal/refine_bio_data/GSE60438/GSE60438.tsv"
tsv_path <- "C:/Users/anae2/Preeclampsia_Vs_Normal/refine_bio_data/GSE60438/GSE60438.tsv"
raw_data <- readr::read_tsv(tsv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

gene_ids <- raw_data[[1]]
sample_names <- colnames(raw_data)[-1]

expr_mat <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(expr_mat) <- gene_ids
colnames(expr_mat) <- sample_names

#reading meta data
meta_path <- "C:/Users/anae2/Preeclampsia_Vs_Normal/refine_bio_data/GSE60438/metadata_GSE60438.tsv"
meta <- readr::read_tsv(meta_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

group_raw <- tolower(paste(
  meta$refinebio_disease_stage,
  meta$`characteristics_ch1_subject status`,
  meta$title,
  meta$description,
  sep = " | "
))

pheno <- tibble::tibble(
  sample = meta$refinebio_accession_code,
  Group  = dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("preeclamp|pre[- ]eclamp|\\bpe\\b", group_raw) ~ "Preeclampsia",
    grepl("normotensive|control", group_raw)              ~ "Control",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sample), !is.na(Group)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Align expression to pheno
expr_mat <- expr_mat[, pheno$sample, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_mat) == pheno$sample))

# Colors and factors used to graphing
grp_cols <- c(Control = "lightblue", Preeclampsia = "pink")
pheno$Group <- factor(pheno$Group, levels = c("Control", "Preeclampsia"))

# Map Ensembl IDs -> HGNC symbols (returns a named character vector)
core_ids <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(expr_mat)) # normalize ENS IDs
syms <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys     = core_ids,
  column   = "SYMBOL",
  keytype  = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

missing <- is.na(syms) | syms == ""
syms[missing] <- rownames(expr_mat)[missing]
names(syms) <- rownames(expr_mat)
attr(syms, "mapping_rate") <- mean(!missing)

gene_lookup <- syms
rowlabs <- unname(gene_lookup[rownames(expr_mat)])
mr <- attr(syms, "mapping_rate")
cat(sprintf("HGNC mapping rate: %.1f%%\n", 100 * mr))


head(syms)

```


```{r}
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
# Remove genes with all-NA or zero variance before ranking
row_vars <- matrixStats::rowVars(expr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
valid <- is.finite(row_vars) & row_vars > 0

expr_mat_valid <- expr_mat[valid, , drop = FALSE]
row_vars_valid <- row_vars[valid]

n_keep <- min(5000L, nrow(expr_mat_valid))
top_idx <- order(row_vars_valid, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(n_keep)]
expr_top <- expr_mat_valid[top_idx, , drop = FALSE]

cat(sprintf("Selected %d most variable genes out of %d\n",
            n_keep, nrow(expr_mat)))
```


```{r}
#data for tidyclust
dat <- t(expr_top) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::as_tibble(rownames = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pheno, by = "sample")

#normalize data
rec <- recipe(~ ., data = dat) %>%
  update_role(sample, Group, new_role = "id") %>%   # keep as identifiers only
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%                    # remove zero-variance cols
  step_normalize(all_predictors())                 # center/scale


#K-mean where k=2
k_spec <- k_means(num_clusters = 2) %>%
  set_engine("stats")

wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(k_spec) %>%
  add_recipe(rec)

fit <- wf %>% fit(dat)

# Get cluster assignments
preds <- predict(fit, dat)  # returns a tibble with .pred_cluster
clusters <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, Group) %>%
  dplyr::bind_cols(preds) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cluster = .pred_cluster)

print(head(clusters))

# check against known groups 
print(table(clusters$cluster, clusters$Group, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r}
#Map each cluster to a "Control-like" / "Preeclampsia-like" label
cluster_map <- clusters %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    major_group = names(sort(table(Group), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_label = paste0(major_group, "-like"))

#Prep data used for PCA
prep_rec <- recipes::prep(rec)
X_tbl <- recipes::bake(prep_rec, new_data = NULL)

X <- X_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample, -Group) %>%
  as.matrix()

pca <- prcomp(X, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
var_expl <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

#plotting frame with cluster labels
clusters_min <- clusters %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster)) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, cluster)

pca_df <- tibble::tibble(
  sample = X_tbl$sample,
  Group  = X_tbl$Group,
  PC1    = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2    = pca$x[, 2]
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(clusters_min, by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cluster_map, by = "cluster")

#Cluster centers in PC space 
centers <- pca_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2), .groups = "drop")

#Plot 
ggplot2::ggplot(pca_df, ggplot2::aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                                     color = cluster_label, shape = Group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  ggplot2::stat_ellipse(
    data = pca_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, group = cluster_label, color = cluster_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    level = 0.75, size = 0.8, linetype = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("Control-like" = "lightblue",
                                         "Preeclampsia-like" = "pink")) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("Control" = 16, "Preeclampsia" = 17)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "PCA of normalized expression",
    subtitle = "Clusters relabeled by majority of known Group",
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%% var)", 100 * var_expl[1]),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%% var)", 100 * var_expl[2]),
    color = "Cluster",
    shape = "Known Group"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
#testing K-means with different K values


# Base PCA frame created from normalized predictors
pca_base <- tibble::tibble(
  sample = X_tbl$sample,
  Group  = X_tbl$Group,
  PC1    = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2    = pca$x[, 2]
)

run_k <- function(k) {
  spec <- tidyclust::k_means(num_clusters = k) %>%
    parsnip::set_engine("stats")

  wf_k <- workflows::workflow() %>%
    workflows::add_model(spec) %>%
    workflows::add_recipe(rec)

  fit_k <- workflows::fit(wf_k, dat)
  preds_k <- predict(fit_k, dat)

  clusters_k <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(sample, Group) %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(preds_k) %>%
    dplyr::rename(cluster = .pred_cluster) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster))


  # Group vs cluster table
  tab_grp <- table(clusters_k$cluster, clusters_k$Group, useNA = "ifany")

  # Join clusters onto PCA for plotting
  pca_k <- pca_base %>%
    dplyr::left_join(clusters_k %>% dplyr::select(sample, cluster), by = "sample")

  # Plots
  plt <- ggplot2::ggplot(pca_k, ggplot2::aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster, shape = Group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::stat_ellipse(ggplot2::aes(group = cluster, color = cluster),
                          level = 0.75, size = 0.8, linetype = 2) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("Control" = 16, "Preeclampsia" = 17)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = sprintf("K-means (k = %d) on PCA of normalized expression", k),
      subtitle = "Shapes = known Group; colors/ellipses = k-means clusters",
      x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%% var)", 100 * var_expl[1]),
      y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%% var)", 100 * var_expl[2]),
      color = "Cluster", shape = "Known Group"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right",
                   panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))

  list(k = k, clusters = clusters_k, tab_grp = tab_grp, plot = plt)
}

# different K values
ks <- c(2, 3, 4, 5)
results <- lapply(ks, run_k)
names(results) <- paste0("k=", ks)

# Print plots
for (nm in names(results)) {
  print(results[[nm]]$plot)
  cat("\nGroup vs cluster table for", nm, ":\n")
  print(results[[nm]]$tab_grp)
}

# Compare membership changes relative to k = 2
k2_clusters <- results[["k=2"]]$clusters %>% dplyr::select(sample, k2 = cluster)

for (k in ks[-1]) {
  kk <- paste0("k=", k)
  trans <- k2_clusters %>%
    dplyr::left_join(results[[kk]]$clusters %>% dplyr::select(sample, kK = cluster), by = "sample")
  cat("\nTransition table: k=2 vs", kk, "\n")
  print(with(trans, table(k2, kK)))
}
```

```{r}
# Compare k-means stability across different numbers of genes (10, 100, 1000, 10000)
set.seed(123)

gene_counts <- c(10, 100, 500, 1000, 2500, 10000)
ks <- c(2, 3, 4, 5)

# Helper: finding top-n (n being the gene counts we want) most variable genes
top_var <- function(expr, n) {
  rv <- matrixStats::rowVars(expr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ok <- is.finite(rv) & rv > 0
  expr_ok <- expr[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  rv_ok <- rv[ok]
  n_keep <- min(n, nrow(expr_ok))
  idx <- order(rv_ok, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(n_keep)]
  expr_ok[idx, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Helper: run k-means for a given gene count across ks
run_for_n <- function(n) {
  expr_n <- top_var(expr_mat, n)

  dat_n <- t(expr_n) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::as_tibble(rownames = "sample") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(pheno, by = "sample")

  rec_n <- recipes::recipe(~ ., data = dat_n) %>%
    recipes::update_role(sample, Group, new_role = "id") %>%
    recipes::step_zv(recipes::all_predictors()) %>%
    recipes::step_normalize(recipes::all_predictors())

  out <- list()
  for (k in ks) {
    spec <- tidyclust::k_means(num_clusters = k) %>%
      parsnip::set_engine("stats")
    wf_k <- workflows::workflow() %>%
      workflows::add_model(spec) %>%
      workflows::add_recipe(rec_n)
    fit_k <- workflows::fit(wf_k, dat_n)
    preds_k <- predict(fit_k, dat_n)

    clusters_k <- dat_n %>%
      dplyr::select(sample) %>%
      dplyr::bind_cols(preds_k) %>%
      dplyr::rename(cluster = .pred_cluster) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster))

    out[[as.character(k)]] <- clusters_k
  }
  out
}

# Run all gene counts
results_by_n <- lapply(gene_counts, run_for_n)
names(results_by_n) <- paste0("genes_", gene_counts)

# Pairwise chi-squared tests between clusterings at the same k, across gene counts ; comparing gene counts and how they also affect the differnet values of K
pair_indices <- combn(seq_along(gene_counts), 2, simplify = FALSE)

chi_rows <- list()
for (k in ks) {
  for (pair in pair_indices) {
    i <- pair[1]; j <- pair[2]
    gi <- paste0("genes_", gene_counts[i])
    gj <- paste0("genes_", gene_counts[j])

    A <- results_by_n[[gi]][[as.character(k)]]
    B <- results_by_n[[gj]][[as.character(k)]]

    # Align by sample and build contingency
    tab <- dplyr::left_join(A, B, by = "sample", suffix = c("_A", "_B")) %>%
      { table(.$cluster_A, .$cluster_B) }

    chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab))
    n <- sum(tab)
    r <- nrow(tab); c <- ncol(tab)
    cramer_v <- sqrt(chi$statistic / (n * min(r - 1, c - 1)))

    chi_rows[[length(chi_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      k = k,
      genes_A = gene_counts[i],
      genes_B = gene_counts[j],
      statistic = as.numeric(chi$statistic),
      df = chi$parameter,
      p_value = chi$p.value,
      cramer_v = as.numeric(cramer_v)
    )
  }
}
chi_results <- do.call(rbind, chi_rows)
chi_results <- chi_results[order(chi_results$k, chi_results$genes_A, chi_results$genes_B), ]

# print the results table
print(chi_results)
write.table(chi_results, "results.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Heatmap of the 5,000 genes used in clustering 

# installing heatmap libraries/ packages
if (!requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pheatmap")
if (!requireNamespace("RColorBrewer", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("RColorBrewer")

# same normalized predictors as clustering
prep_rec <- recipes::prep(rec)
X_tbl <- recipes::bake(prep_rec, new_data = NULL)
X <- X_tbl %>% dplyr::select(-sample, -Group) %>% as.matrix()   # samples x genes (z-scored by recipe)

# Convert to genes x samples for heatmap; label rows with HGNC symbols where available
heat_mat <- t(X)
rowlabs_top <- unname(gene_lookup[colnames(X)])  # colnames(X) are the gene IDs used
rownames(heat_mat) <- rowlabs_top
colnames(heat_mat) <- X_tbl$sample

# (k = 2)
get_kmeans_clusters <- function(k) {
  spec <- tidyclust::k_means(num_clusters = k) %>% parsnip::set_engine("stats")
  wf_k <- workflows::workflow() %>% workflows::add_model(spec) %>% workflows::add_recipe(rec)
  fit_k <- workflows::fit(wf_k, dat)
  tibble::tibble(
    sample = dat$sample,
    !!paste0("k", k) := as.character(predict(fit_k, dat)$.pred_cluster)
  )
}

cl2 <- get_kmeans_clusters(2)

# Build annotation data frame for samples 
ann_df <- X_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, Group) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cl2, by = "sample")

ann <- ann_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, k2) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(ann) <- ann_df$sample

# Colors for annotation bars
library(RColorBrewer)
grp_cols <- c(Control = "lightblue", Preeclampsia = "pink")
mk_pal <- function(n) brewer.pal(max(3, n), "Set2")[seq_len(n)]
k2_lvls <- sort(unique(ann$k2))
ann_colors <- list(
  Group = grp_cols,
  k2 = setNames(mk_pal(length(k2_lvls)), k2_lvls)
)

# plot heatmap w/ annotation sidebar
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  heat_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(101),
  scale = "none",                     # already z-scored by recipe
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  annotation_col = ann,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  main = "5,000 most variable genes (normalized); annotations: Group, k=2 clusters"
)
```
